response.message: Astra: Your summaries now describe measurement work, but the visible activity is revising text and inventing examples—not collecting measurements. Stay with numerical integrity rather than starting a new measurement task. Look closely at the example you first wrote and your later retelling of it: which entry deserves comparison before you trust the retelling? Spend attention on that evidence rather than another improvement list. In English, explain what this comparison establishes about your writing, and what it cannot establish about any real measurement.
response.rationale: Redirects repetitive planning toward a concrete comparison within the existing project, distinguishing textual evidence from invented measurement history.
